# URLPulse

> URLPulse is a bulk URL health-monitoring application. Users submit many URLs (manually or via CSV); URLPulse checks each one independently in the background and reports status, response time, and page title, with real-time progress.

URLPulse is built with Next.js, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Redis, and BullMQ. PostgreSQL is the authoritative source of truth; a separate worker performs the checks under a global outbound rate limit and concurrency cap.
